title: Industrial Hip Hop
style: EDM, Metal, Hip Hop, Male Vocals, Harmonized Vocals, Growling, Rap Vocals, Cinematic, Aggressive, Bass, Electric Guitar, Rhythm Guitar, Drums, Keyboard, Synth, build a dystopian heavy metal trap beat with EDM elements and over the top excitement filling the voids with echoes and haunting house
lyrics:
(INTRO — “Static Pulse”)

(echoed vox, machine-filtered)
Pulse in the wire...
Shadows in the code...
Rebels in the fire...
Where the neon blood flows...



(VERSE 1 — “Street-Level Chopper”)

Sirens in my spinal line, crackle through the metal spine
Neon in my bloodstream glowin’ like a shattered shrine.
Carbon in the arteries—city full of darker things
Dead men walkin’ with a barcode where the heart should be.

Steel-breath prophecy, ghost-form odyssey
Flicker in the alley when the drones start watchin’ me.
Every step encrypted like a cipher in a coffin
Every rebel that was taken—yo, their eyes still talkin’.

Rain on the chrome like a resurrection hymn
Circuit boards hummin’ with the voices of the dim.
I move through the night like a glitch that escaped
’Cause the system wrote my death, but the code got erased.



(HOOK — “Neon Haunting”)

(big, soaring, eerie)
We are the ghosts in the neon blood
Risin’ from the circuitry, crawl out the flood.
You can cage the flesh, but you can’t stop the grid
We’re the shadows in the system that the empire hid.

Ghosts in the neon blood...
Ghosts in the neon blood...
We live forever in the static and the thrum—
Rebellion ain’t dead... it just learns to run.



(VERSE 2 — “Rebel Cipher Run”)

Faded on the backstreet, thermal lens track me
But the ghosts in the code keep the empire from snatchin’ me.
Hologram soldiers march in the rain
But the ghost-wave rebels put a crack in the chain.

Backdoor breach—hit the firewall’s spine
Reroute truth through the pulse of the line.
Every revolution needs a whisper in the wires
Every tyrant needs a match and a spark to the fire.

Synth-heart thumpin’ with a rage unbound
I hear the fallen in the static—every lost one's sound.
We ain’t dyin’, we dividin’, we collide then rise—
Binary angels with electric eyes.



(BRIDGE — “Signal of the Fallen”)

(filter sweeps, vocoder undertones)
Can you hear ’em...
In the towers...
In the code...
In the power...
Every soul they tried to crush
Comin’ back like voltage dust...



(VERSE 3 — “Revolt Protocol”)

Hardline heartbeat, rebels in the deep grid
Phantoms of the empire that the network never did rid.
Breaking every algorithm that was written to erase us
Standing with the specters of the ones who tried to save us.

Chrome-wing martyrs, runnin' through the sectors
Binary prophets in the ruins of collectors.
Neon veins glow with the rage of the lost—
We’re the ghosts in the night and we’re cuttin’ the cost.



(OUTRO — “Shutdown Prayer”)

(slow... echoing down a digital corridor)
When the empire falls...
And the city goes numb...
Remember the ghosts...
Who taught the code to run.
